in_marathi.name: Devvrat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devvrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devvrat is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘deva’ meaning god and ‘vrat’ meaning promise or vow. The name signifies a divine promise made by the deity to his devotee or a promise made by an individual to a deity. It embodies the idea of faith and devotion.
